items.title: Perl PublicSuffix更新RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者控制更新列表并具模块写权限时，可注入代码经update_self_from_url重写源文件

items.description: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl allow code injection via a fetched list line that closes the built-in data heredoc when update_self_from_url rewrites the module's source. The attacker must control the fetched list, through the cleartext default URL or a caller-supplied one, and the updater must run with write access to the installed module.

Attackers can reach the method through Craft Commerce's payments/pay redirect template calling customer.photo.getUrl() with a crafted transform to instantiate classes like yii\rbac\PhpManager and execute PHP.

items.title: MySQL 命令注入
items.description: Prior to 0.31.1, the database password validation used by the MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, and Redis change-password procedures permits backticks, and the procedures interpolate attacker-controlled passwords into Bash command strings. An authenticated user who can update a database password can trigger command substitution before the database command runs, resulting in arbitrary operating-system command execution with the Dokploy process privileges, which are typically root.

items.title: Dokploy 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the Nixpacks publishDirectory build setting accepts shell metacharacters and is interpolated into a docker cp command executed through child_process.exec. An authenticated user with access to an application can execute arbitrary commands on the Dokploy host when triggering a Nixpacks deployment, leading to host compromise through the privileged Docker environment. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.

items.title: Dokploy 命令注入(RCE)

items.description: ThinkPHP 2.0 through 2.2 and 3.0 Lite mode contains an eval injection vulnerability in the Dispatcher PATH_INFO parsing, which uses preg_replace with the /e modifier and a double-quoted replacement. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted requests to index.php with a malicious 's' parameter containing PHP expressions to execute arbitrary code on the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

Attackers can send POST requests to endpoints reached via ?s=captcha or ?s=index/index/index with filter[]=system and server[REQUEST_METHOD] values to execute arbitrary system commands. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

items.title: TeamCity YAML路径遍历RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过流水线YAML文件路径遍历写入或执行代码，可能远程控制TeamCity服务器。
items.action_zh: 升级至2026.1.3或2025.11.7；限制流水线配置权限。
items.repro_note: 可能需流水线配置权限，向YAML文件路径注入遍历序列
items.impact_scope: CI服务器，掌握源码与部署凭据
items.description: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 remote code execution was possible via path traversal in the pipeline YAML file path

items.title: TeamCity外部制品缓存路径遍历RCE
items.title_zh: TeamCity外部制品缓存路径遍历RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用外部制品缓存路径遍历实现远程代码执行，可控制CI服务器。
items.action_zh: 升级至2026.1.3或2025.11.7；限制制品缓存配置权限。
items.repro_note: 可能需制品缓存配置权限，构造遍历路径读写并触发RCE
items.impact_scope: CI服务器，掌握源码与部署凭据
items.description: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 remote code execution was possible via path traversal in the external artifact cache

items.title: NocoDB OAuth令牌越权为完整会话
items.title_zh: NocoDB OAuth令牌越权为完整会话
items.summary_zh: 持有低权限OAuth令牌者可绕过会话校验，获取授权用户全部权限。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至2026.10.1；轮换JWT密钥并收紧OAuth令牌权限。
items.repro_note: 需低权限OAuth令牌，尝试session或NocoSocket交换获取全权限
items.impact_scope: 数据协作平台，可能暴露内网数据
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows OAuth token holders to act as full sessions because OAuth access tokens are signed with the instance JWT secret. Attackers can present a narrowly scoped OAuth token to the session strategy, short-lived-token exchange, or NocoSocket handshake to gain the granting user's full privileges.

items.title: 联邦信任源校验缺失致身份冒充
items.title_zh: 联邦信任源校验缺失致身份冒充
items.summary_zh: 攻击者污染信任配置并跨刷新持久化，可冒充成员和安全服务器。
items.difficulty: 高(远程·利用条件苛刻·需高权限)
items.action_zh: 校验并清理联邦信任源，限制配置写入，关注官方修复。
items.repro_note: 需能污染联邦信任源配置，观察刷新后持久化及冒充效果
items.impact_scope: 联邦身份体系，横向信任扩散
items.description: A malicious or compromised federated ecosystem can provide a validly signed SHARED-PARAMETERS part naming a victim ecosystem, causing the part to be written as the victim's authoritative shared-params.xml. The poisoned configuration can persist across refreshes, add attacker-controlled trust material, and enable impersonation of victim members and Security Servers across every ecosystem federated with the malicious source.

items.title: Craft CMS低权限SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 低权限认证用户经地址接口传入嵌套数组，盲注读取数据库内容。
items.action_zh: 升级至5.11.5；限制低权限账号并过滤嵌套数组参数。
items.repro_note: 认证低权限用户向users/save-address等传嵌套数组触发盲注
items.impact_scope: CMS后台，低权限账号可横向窃取数据
items.description: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.5 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to inject raw SQL by passing nested array parameters into Element::findOne() criteria. Attackers can set the query's where property through endpoints like users/delete-address and users/save-address to perform blind boolean or time-based injection and read database contents.

items.title: atomic-server 缺失认证
items.affected: rust:atomic-server >= 0.29.0, <= 0.40.1
items.description: An **unauthenticated** attacker who sends `GET /setup?public-key=<attacker_key>` has the server create a new Agent and grant it **write access to the entire Drive**. ## Severity **Critical — CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H (9.8).** No authentication required; grants attacker-controlled write over all resources in the Drive.

items.title: JWT鉴权中间件令牌伪造致提权
items.title_zh: JWT鉴权中间件令牌伪造致提权
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可自签含高权限声明的令牌，绕过鉴权并获得特权。
items.action_zh: 修复JWT校验逻辑，强制从数据库重载用户权限并轮换密钥。
items.repro_note: 未授权构造并自签高权限JWT，提交至受保护接口验证越权
items.impact_scope: CI/鉴权中间件，可致全面越权
items.description: An unauthenticated attacker can sign a self-contained token with privileged claims because server/src/auth/auth_jwt.js verifies the signature without reloading the user from the database, and server/src/lib/middleware.js trusts the token's roles and options for authorization. A forged token can therefore be accepted as an administrator session, resulting in authentication bypass and full privileged API access.

items.title: 文件链接绕过
items.description: Incus before 7.6.0 fails to reject special files, hard links, or symlinks in backup or image metadata, allowing restricted project users to read or overwrite host files. Attackers can import crafted backups containing device nodes, a hard-linked backup.yaml, or symlinks to corrupt host storage, overwrite host files, or leak other projects' data.

items.title: Incus 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious migration peers to write outside intended directories by supplying unvalidated dependent volume and snapshot names in the migration offer header. Attackers controlling a migration source can create root-owned volumes with attacker content at arbitrary host paths, compromising hosts using dir storage pools, bypassing restricted.storage-pools.access, or crashing the daemon.

items.title: yt加载HDF5参数注入致代码执行
items.title_zh: yt加载HDF5参数注入致代码执行
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造恶意ytdata HDF5文件，诱导用户加载后执行任意Python代码。
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至4.4.4以上；禁止加载不可信HDF5文件并隔离运行。
items.repro_note: 构造恶意ytdata HDF5，诱导yt.load()触发eval
items.impact_scope: 科研/数据分析环境，用户级代码执行
items.description: yt through 4.4.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute Python code by supplying a crafted con_args attribute in a ytdata HDF5 file. SavedDataset._parse_parameter_file() passes con_args to eval() unrestricted, so loading a malicious .h5 file with yt.load() runs attacker code as the user.

items.title: Unauthenticated 未授权 任意文件上传
items.description: Baidu UEditor 1.4.0 through 1.4.3.3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the catchimage action of /ueditor/net/controller.ashx that only validates the Content-Type header. Unauthenticated attackers can supply a source[] URL like x.jpg?.aspx to retain a malicious extension and write an executable .aspx file for remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-17.

items.title: 未授权 任意文件上传
items.description: iDocView before 13.10.1_20231115 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the /html/2word endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files by supplying a malicious url parameter. Attackers can send a crafted GET request with the url parameter to download linked resources with an unsanitized path and unblocked .jsp extension, achieving remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-11-22.

items.title: GET 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: Prior to 1.11.5, the unauthenticated GET /api/v1/view/* route in server/src/routes/api/v1/view/root.ts resolves its attacker-controlled wildcard path without normalization or containment, allowing traversal outside the intended uploads directory and arbitrary server file reads. Reading environment files can disclose DB_SECRET_KEY, the application’s JWT signing key, which permits forged administrator tokens and takeover of bots, conversations, integrations, and stored third-party credentials.

items.title: Incus 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users permitted to import custom volumes to store unvalidated snapshot names from the backup index configuration section. Attackers can craft a backup with traversal sequences in snapshot names so later deletion removes arbitrary host directories as root, while renaming or mounting operates on arbitrary paths.

items.title: Deleting 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: A standard authenticated user can associate the malicious filename with the user's own QSO, satisfy the ownership check, escape the per-user QSL image directory, and delete files writable by the PHP worker. Deleting configuration or operational files can cause denial of service, while deleting installer gate files can reopen the unauthenticated installer and enable application identity takeover through attacker-controlled database configuration.

items.title: TeamCity代理命令结果致DoS
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可滥用代理命令结果触发TeamCity服务拒绝，影响CI可用性。
items.action_zh: 升级至2026.1.3或2025.11.7；限制代理命令结果处理。
items.repro_note: 需可控制代理命令结果，向TeamCity提交异常结果观察DoS
items.impact_scope: CI服务器，可能中断构建流水线
items.description: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 DoS via agent command results was possible

items.title: Helpdesk 未授权 任意文件上传
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in its e-mail-based Helpdesk ticket intake. A remote unauthenticated attacker can e-mail a Helpdesk ticket with such an attachment; in the default configuration, anyone can request the uploaded file's URL which executes attacker-supplied code with the privileges of the web server process.

items.title: 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: The /api/subtitles/subtitles handler in subtitles.py passes caller-supplied path and reference to sync and translation without per-path authorization, allowing an out-of-library reference file to be read and output to overwrite a file outside the media library.

items.title: QSO 未授权 SQL注入
items.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can use UNION-based SQL injection to read arbitrary application database records, including account data, password hashes, API keys, station credentials, reset tokens, QSO data, and station metadata. Disclosure of password reset tokens can be combined with the forgot_password workflow to take over accounts, including administrator accounts.

items.title: Traversal 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: Traversal sequences can escape the image directory and overwrite process-writable files, including DATABASE_PATH for the live SQLite database, while the client-supplied image content type does not validate the uploaded bytes. An attacker can replace the database to plant an administrative user and can overwrite other writable files, causing full application compromise and availability loss.

items.title: AnsibleForms仓库参数注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 具仓库管理权限用户可向uri/branch/name/host注入shell命令执行代码。
items.action_zh: 升级至6.2.1；限制仓库管理权限并过滤命令参数。
items.repro_note: 需仓库管理权限，在仓库URI/分支/名称等注入shell命令
items.impact_scope: CI/运维平台，可执行服务器命令
items.description: Prior to 6.2.1, AnsibleForms allows a user with repository management privileges to inject shell syntax through repository uri, branch, name, or host values processed by server/src/models/repo.model.js. The Repo.clone and Repo.addKnownHosts paths interpolate these values into git and ssh-keyscan command strings, and server/src/lib/cmd.js executes the strings through Cmd.executeSilentCommand with shell interpretation enabled.

items.title: DOCS_DIR 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: The vulnerable tool is implemented in zyrabit-slm/api-rag/app/domain/services/mcp_service.py, where Path(DOCS_DIR) / destination_name is passed to shutil.copy2, allowing traversal or an absolute destination to write outside the vault. When ENABLE_LEGACY_EXTENSIONS=true, zyrabit-slm/api-rag/app/main.py registers POST /mcp/rpc without get_current_user, allowing unauthenticated network tool calls; this optional exposure is disabled by default and is not required for local invocation.

items.title: OIDC 未授权 随机熵不足
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: Administrators who set ood_oidc_crypto_passphrase can therefore believe a strong secret is configured while the deployment continues to use an attacker-derivable value. In OIDCSessionType client-cookie deployments, an unauthenticated remote attacker can derive the encryption key and forge a mod_auth_openidc_session cookie for another user, while server-cache deployments permit lower-impact tampering with protected OIDC state and nonce cookies.

items.title: Vulnerabilities 未授权 权限提升
items.description: Vulnerabilities in the PAPI protocol of AOS-10 could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to circumvent existing authentication controls. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to gain administrative access, modify system configurations, and access or manipulate sensitive data.

items.title: Incus 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to authenticate as any trusted certificate by appending its public certificate to their presented TLS client chain. Attackers can append the server's or a cluster member's certificate to gain cluster-level access, bypass authorization, modify trust store entries, and influence scriptlet-based authorization decisions.

items.title: Fleet 签名校验错误
items.description: Fleet from 4.71.0 before 4.88.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the SAML SSO callback that looks up sessions using unvalidated client-supplied identifiers. Users able to run live queries or enroll secret holders can plant attacker-controlled identity provider metadata in the session store, then present a self-signed SAML response to log in as a global admin.

items.title: Incus 授权错误
items.description: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass that allows restricted project users to create resources in the unrestricted default project by targeting projects lacking features.* flags. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq dhcp-script injection to run scripts as root, or custom volumes with block.create_options mkfs arguments to read host files.

items.title: Incus 授权错误
items.description: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted clients to create and access default project resources by exploiting entitlement checks against the requested project. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq directives to execute code as root on the host, or manipulate inherited resources via the ?project= parameter.

items.title: Dokploy 缺失授权(越权)
items.description: Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). From 0.29.13 until 0.31.0, the Docker terminal, container-log, and monitoring WebSocket handlers accept a caller-controlled serviceId as authorization but do not consistently bind the requested containerId or appName to that service.

items.title: POST 未授权 缺失认证
items.description: MeterSphere versions 1.13.0 before 1.14.7 and 1.15.0 before 1.16.4 contain a pre-authentication code injection vulnerability due to the /plugin/** endpoints being exposed with anonymous access. Attackers can upload a malicious jar via POST /plugin/add and invoke it through POST /plugin/customMethod using the 'entry' and 'request' parameters, which are passed to Class.forName and method invocation for remote code execution.

items.title: Dagu 未授权 缺失认证
items.description: Dagu 1.23.0 before 2.0.0 defaults auth.mode to none, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute OS commands through the /api/v2/dag-runs endpoint. Attackers can send a POST request with an inline spec defining steps containing arbitrary shell commands to achieve remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-03-11.

items.title: ArangoDB 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: ArangoDB before 3.12.11 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability caused by a parser differential between the raw path authentication gate and the URL-decoded dispatch logic. Attackers can send requests with a %5f-encoded leading underscore to endpoints like /_db/_system/%5fapi/simple/first-example to reach /_api/* actions as superuser without authentication. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-09-16.

items.title: Unauthenticated 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: All versions of LaraDashboard contain an authentication bypass in SocialAuthService::findOrCreateUser(), which links a social login to an existing account by email without checking that the OAuth provider verified that email. Unauthenticated attackers using an OAuth/OIDC provider that asserts a victim's email can log in as any user, including Superadmin, and keep persistent access through a linked social_accounts entry.

items.title: NocoDB 越权(IDOR)
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated Creators to access another tenant's external database by reusing a victim source id when adding a source. Because NcConnectionMgrv2 caches connections by bare source id, attackers can reflect the victim's cached database schema and read, update, and insert records through their own base models.

items.title: Airlock Gateway 未授权 堆溢出
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: A bug in the Airlock Gateway (8.5.2 and earlier, and 8.6.0) allows attacker-controlled HTML in a backend response to exploit the Smart Form Protection feature, possibly leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) or Remote Code Execution (RCE) attack against the Airlock Gateway. Successfully exploiting the vulnerability can enable an attacker to perform a DoS attack or, in the worst case, an RCE attack against the Airlock Gateway in front of the affected backend.

items.title: LMS CWE-829
items.description: LMS (Lan Management System) is vulnerable to privilege escalation in the lmsd daemon. Because the example systemd unit does not set a separate user, lmsd runs as root, allowing the attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.

items.title: Hardcoded 未授权 硬编码凭据
items.description: Hardcoded credentials in the executable file. These can be extracted using the “Strings.exe” tool and could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the database and SMTP server. winCRM.exe

items.title: Hardcoded 未授权 硬编码凭据
items.description: Hardcoded credentials in the executable file. These can be extracted using the “Strings.exe” tool and could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the database and SMTP server. winSAT.exe

items.title: ZIP 未授权 缺失认证
items.description: Prior to 2.7.2, the unauthenticated /api/v1/database/import handler in backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/database.py accepts a ZIP archive and moves an included database file to DATABASE_PATH while also replacing IMAGE_PATH content. An attacker can supply a database containing an attacker-controlled users table and administrative account, then authenticate as that account; invalid replacement data can also destroy application data or availability.

items.title: JWTs 未授权 认证欺骗
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can register a malicious identity provider, create users matching existing administrative usernames, and obtain valid JWTs which will be accepted by the application. This results in complete authentication bypass and privilege escalation to administrative access.

items.title: Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central 命令注入(RCE)
items.affected: ManageEngine(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central build below 6500 are affected by a authenticated PowerShell command injection vulnerability in the Telnet connectivity feature, allowing specially crafted IPv6 scope identifiers to execute arbitrary commands on managed Windows nodes.

items.title: Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central 命令注入(RCE)
items.affected: ManageEngine(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central build below 6500 are affected by a authenticated command injection vulnerability in the Windows DDI Agent's clear_blocked_domains functionality, allowing specially crafted blocked-domain values to trigger arbitrary command execution on Windows systems.

items.title: Dell PowerStore 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. Exploitation could lead to arbitrary command execution with root privileges on the appliance.

items.title: GearUP Hyperev 命令注入
items.description: A vulnerability was found in GearUP Hyperev up to 20261020. This impacts the function get_wlan_sitesurvey of the file ld/utils.lua of the component WLAN Site Survey. Performing a manipulation of the argument line results in os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: SiYuan XSS
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.description: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in genAVValueHTML() that allows attackers who can store Attribute View asset values to inject script through an unescaped image src attribute. Attackers can store an image URL containing a double quote and onerror handler that executes OS commands via Node.js in the desktop app when victims open the bound note or row attribute panel.

items.title: Node.js XSS
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.description: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability, an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-44670, because renderAVAttribute() inserts an Attribute View name unescaped into the database row attribute panel header. Attackers who can persist the name, such as via the setAttrViewName action, can inject an onerror handler that runs OS commands through Node.js when a desktop user opens the panel.

items.title: Deserialization 反序列化(RCE)
items.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Rymera Web Co Product Feed PRO for WooCommerce woo-product-feed-pro allows Object Injection.This issue affects Product Feed PRO for WooCommerce: from n/a through 13.5.8.

items.title: NocoDB 代码注入(RCE)
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator-role users to execute server-side JavaScript by supplying array-form property paths to Handlebars helpers in webhook templates. Attackers can bypass the string-only prototype guard to reach the function constructor, running operating-system commands with server privileges or exfiltrating process-internal values via outbound requests.

items.title: NocoDB 代码注入(RCE)
items.description: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Owner users to execute JavaScript by abusing Handlebars webhook helpers.
